tagline: Monte取景器相机，1952 年发布
description: Monte于1952年推出的取景器相机。配备Monte Anastigmat 1:3.5/50mm, 4 elements。快门速度leaf-shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/200 sec. plus S mode, K mode and K/B-mode。使用35mm。

specs.快门: leaf-shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/200 sec. plus S mode, K mode and K/B-mode
specs.英文简介: The Monte 35 (the actual cameras are engraved Monte-35 or MONTE35) was a fine viewfinder camera made by the Japanese camera maker Shinsei Optical Works since 1952.
